We evaluate the quality of generated completions from three aspects: (1) fluency, (2) n-gram matching with ground-truth continuation, and (3) semantic similarity with ground-truth continuation. Fluency is evaluated by perplexity computed from Pythia-1B model pre-trained using C4. N-gram matching and semantic similarity are measured by ROUGE-L and BERTScore respectively.
